ops.title: cc-squash: port the last three test files off the deleted daemonkit packages (production migration is done and gate-green)
ops.description:
Resumable. Branch `dk-migrate` in the worktree `~/.claude/worktrees/cc-squash/dk-migrate`, two commits on top of `af48202`, **unpushed** — deliberately, because the production code compiles but three test files do not, and a main whose `go test ./...` fails is worse than a red fleet leg.

## What is already done

`bdbea78 refactor: migrate the control plane onto daemonkit v0.23` moved the production code off `daemonkit/{daemon,proc,service,trust,wire,worker}` onto the v0.23 surface. `2020581` fixed a codegen test whose enum the migration deleted.

**`cd go && go build ./...` and `go vet ./...` (non-test) are clean**, and the daemonkit fleet-build leg **passes**:

    PASS*  cc-squash  darwin  ref main  pin v0.23.0  .../cc-squash/go (dk-migrate)

run 2026-08-30 against daemonkit `6b64e80`, in a 5/5 sweep alongside cc-runtime, synckit, captain-hook, and cc-pool. The leg compiles non-test code, which is why it passes while the suite does not.

Currently green: `internal/cli`, `internal/config`, `internal/control/gen`, `internal/paths`, `internal/supervisor`.

## What remains — 1567 lines across three files

| file | lines | still imports |
|---|---|---|
| `go/internal/control/server_test.go` | 905 | `daemonkit/daemon`, `daemonkit/proc` |
| `go/internal/proxyseam/seam_test.go` | 498 | the deleted peer/identity surface |
| `go/internal/control/client_test.go` | 164 | `daemonkit/wire` |

Both packages currently report `[setup failed]`.

## Decisions already made — do not re-litigate

1. **The proxy seam moves onto `ChannelHandoff`** (`Ctx.Spawn(ctx, Cmd{...}, daemonkit.ChannelHandoff, logFile)` speaking the existing JSON line protocol over `Child.Conn()`), replacing the `proxy-v1.sock` listener, its file lock, `ExpectProcess`, and the four-field `matchesIdentity` peer check. This is strictly stronger — a kernel socketpair with no path to squat, and daemonkit pins the child's audit token while it is suspended. **The Rust `crates/ccs-proxy` takes the inherited fd 3 instead of `--socket <path>`.** Rejected alternatives: same-EUID + PID (a security downgrade — reopens a PID-reuse race) and hand-porting daemonkit's private `kern.proc` reads.
2. Health moved from the business-lane `OpRuntimeHealth` route to the trust-gated `Control.Health()`, product data in `Health.Detail`.
3. Trust keeps the signed `SXKCTF23Q2`/`ccs` requirement on the control lane and `ServingSameUser()` for business.
4. The control socket is daemonkit-owned at `~/.daemonkit/a/<Label>/`; live daemons are abandoned in place, no migration.

## Why it stopped here

The account hit its weekly usage limit mid-run (resets 2026-09-02), and all seven agents of the rewrite workflow died on it. The workflow script is saved and resumable at
`~/.claude/projects/-Users-yasyf-Code-daemonkit/<session>/workflows/scripts/ccsquash-daemonkit-rewrite-wf_5a29bbe6-d92.js`;
it carries the full brief, the reference consumers to copy (cc-interact `daemon/server.go` is the closest analogue), and the four-part definition of done.

**Watch for self-exec `TestMain` patterns** in the files being ported — a dropped env-var branch turns a suite into a fork bomb.</body>

ops.text: internal/control/server_test.go, internal/control/client_test.go, and internal/proxyseam/seam_test.go compile and pass against daemonkit v0.23.0, with no import of daemonkit/{daemon,proc,wire,trust,worker,service}

Every test function present at af48202 is either re-expressed on the new surface or explicitly recorded as pinning a deleted mechanism (the four-field peer-identity match, the proxy-v1.sock file lock, the verifier child)
`cd go && go test -race -count=1 ./...` is green, and the branch is pushed to cc-squash main with a v0.12.0 release cut
The Rust ccs-proxy takes the inherited fd 3 rather than --socket <path>, and `cargo build` is clean
